Bill.BriefDescription: Eliminating the state certificate of need process.

BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The certificate of need process establishedin chapter 70.38 RCW is hereby abolished. By November 15, 2009, thecode reviser shall recommend to the legislature appropriate legislationthat effectuates the purposes of this act by removing references to thecertificate of need process in sections of the Revised Code ofWashington not repealed by this act.
